entities.summary: Edwin Vincent Byrne was an American prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as archbishop of the Archdiocese of Santa Fe in New Mexico from 1943 to 1963. He previously served in Puerto Rico as bishop of the Diocese of Ponce from 1925 to 1929 and as bishop of the Diocese of San Juan de Puerto Rico from 1929 to 1943.
